title: Elderscrolls Morrowind Mods Map
transportLoadError: Transport data could not be loaded.
transportPropylonRequired: Requires the destination's propylon index, or a master index if available in your game.
transportConditional: Availability may depend on quests or other conditions.
transportSkyRestricted: Requires access to House Redoran's services; the route may be temporarily unavailable.
transportQuestRestricted: Special transport: availability depends on quests and circumstances.
transportFolmsMaster: Folms Mirel transports you to the propylon when you have the Master Index.
transportFolms: Travel through Folms Mirel; availability depends on the index quest.
transportMournholdDetails: Mournhold's map position is approximate. In Tribunal, the journey is tied to the story; the method and conditions may vary with the mod setup.
transportMournholdReturn: This is the city's approximate location; Mournhold's separate map is not shown. In Tribunal, speak to Effe-Tei in the palace to return.
transportHolamayan: Available after the main quest opens the way to Holamayan.
transportRavenRock: Requires progress in the Raven Rock colony quest.
transportNoDepartures: No departures in the selected networks.
transportBackdropRequired: Enable Tamriel Rebuilt, Project Cyrodiil or Skyrim: Home of the Nords to show this point.
routeClickFrom: Click the map to choose your starting point.
routeClickTo: Click the map to choose your destination.
routeCaveat: Dotted lines are straight-line walks: roads, water and terrain are not considered. Walk up to 8 cells to a stop and 1.5 cells between stops.
routeChooseBoth: Choose a starting point and a destination.
routeDisabledPlace: A selected place belongs to a disabled mod. Enable it or choose another place.
routeNoTransport: Enable at least one transport type in the filters.
routeNoResults: No routes found with these filters. Try different points or transport types.

creditTamrielRebuilt: by the Tamriel Rebuilt team: the Morrowind mainland.
creditProjectTamriel: by the Project Tamriel team: Project Cyrodiil and Skyrim: Home of the Nords.
creditTamrielData: by the Tamriel Rebuilt and Project Tamriel teams: the textures their lands use.
creditTotsp: by Wollirollo and others: Solstheim remade.
creditWyrmhaven: by Neoptolemus: an island west of Solstheim.
creditWhiteWolf: by Emma and TeuTonic: Lokken island.
creditAzurian: by Melchior Dahrk: islands between Tamriel and Akavir.
creditOaabData: the textures and models the Azurian Isles use.
creditTamriel: the landmass of the whole continent, drawn where the other mods have no land yet.
creditRussianMorrowind: in Russian, by 1C: the Russian names of Morrowind and Bloodmoon.
creditRussianWhiteWolf: by Belchonok for TESALL.RU, edited by Pirate.
creditTes3: by Greatness7: the library that reads the plugin and archive files.
creditsNote: This is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Bethesda Softworks or the mod teams. The map images and place names belong to their authors.
interventionPickHint: Select a point or location on the map
interventionChoose: Select a location or choose a point on the map.
interventionMissing: No destination in the enabled modules
interventionNote: Calculated for the selected exterior cell. Interiors, teleport restrictions and other active plugins can change the result.
interventionAmbiguous: Several markers share the destination cell; the exact point depends on the game.
interventionNoData: Intervention data is unavailable. Regenerate the transport data.
interventionMissingSets: Intervention data is missing for: {modules}. The result may differ.
legendInfoComplete: Data is available for all map modules.
